d: Ever started one episode of Mirzapur, Panchayat, Sacred Games, The Family Man, Money Heist or Stranger Things and ended up finishing the whole season in one night? That’s binge watching. In this video we break down why India has become one of the world’s fastest binge-watching countries, how OTT platforms like Netflix and Amazon Prime changed everything, and what really happens inside your brain.You’ll learn about the dopamine reward system, cliffhangers, FOMO, peer pressure and the rabbit-hole effect that keep you glued to the screen.
